entities.summary: Saad Bachir Lamjarred is a Moroccan singer, songwriter, actor, multi-instrumentalist, dancer, and record producer. He is widely known for his music video "LM3ALLEM" which received over 1 billion views on YouTube, making it the most-viewed Arabic music video on YouTube. His music videos are among the most watched in the MENA region and the most viewed in Morocco.
